notes.text: The opening writes the Sigma12 expression, followed by the source words ‘signifierait que’, a disjoint-sum display, and two displayed Pi decompositions. The following source conclusion reads Pi1=Pi3, followed by ‘contrairement : l’hypothèse’. The written final 3 and colon are preserved. The surrounding names Pi1 and Pi2 were recognized as a mathematical cue, not used to replace the final digit.

An annotation beneath the first displayed Sigma2+ uses two short vertical strokes as a vertical equality mark, then the negative-Sigma expression. Its lower index is heavily overwritten. The first reading of the live index remains 1, while the old index and long horizontal at X remain uncertain. The clear final positive-Sigma index 1 was checked visually but does not determine the obscured index.

The author replaces the underlined, cancelled heading ‘Corollaire’ with ‘Proposition’. The paragraph concerns two ‘décompositions binaires’ and uses the words ‘mutuellement non panachées’, then an underlined ‘unique’. Its ordered pair and the following empty-intersection display are transcribed. The first ordered-pair superscript has a horizontal cap and downward stem; the visibly fuller nearby plus is a comparator, not a reason to fill the missing upper arm.

Two separated vertical emphasis strokes occur in the left margin: a long one beside the binaires/Alors lines and a short one beside tel. Both are represented with LaTeX rules at those positions. C’s explicit comment already identifies both scopes, and H’s editorial note acknowledges marginal emphasis; no independent omission claim is made from their macro arrangements.

The lower block defines C by the displayed sum of the Pi and omega terms and calls it ‘l’ensemble somme, qui a quatre éléments’. The next display is an application with a script-P target. The target subscript remains finies/fermés/fermé-uncertain. The text then lists four Sigma terms as its image. No interpretation of the target subscript was imposed from the surrounding mathematics.

The page ends with ‘et laquelle on l’identifie si (18) est injective, i.e.’ The written et is retained. The last abbreviation is not expanded in the transcription. No following page was inspected and no continuation supplied.

The display labels 18 and 19 preserve earlier 7 and 8 respectively; the final inline 18 preserves an earlier 7. Each reading follows surviving numeral strokes. H’s explicit note recognizes rewritten display numbering, so the reported additional material is the old numeral itself, not an invented omission of revision state. Crop 10 was made for label 17 because H also describes it as rewritten; that crop did not yield a separately decipherable prior numeral, and (17) is retained without inventing one.

No source date or separate author page number is visible. The pencil 34 at the lower left is treated as archive sheet numbering and retained as a TeX comment. The page has handwritten prose and displays, the correction/addition layers inventoried above, and emphasis strokes; it contains no independent drawn figure or commutative diagram. No mathematical proof check or computation was performed.

workflow_feedback.brief: reader_brief_v07.md followed; current notation table and every page-specific packet text input were read.
workflow_feedback.image_order: Whole image once for layout, half a once, half b once, then each of 15 enlarged local crops once.
workflow_feedback.crop_processing: Single crop operation per open locus; original-coordinate boxes; width 3000 px; LANCZOS; autocontrast; UnsharpMask. No rotation was needed.
workflow_feedback.target_clipping: No target mark was clipped. Incidental neighboring strokes enter some crop boundaries; they were not re-cropped.
workflow_feedback.coordinate_system: All bbox values use the 1693 by 2362 original whole image. Half b begins at whole y=1101.
workflow_feedback.closed_loci: Clear half-settled differences, including alors, heading emphasis, absent formula point and final et, have exact whole-image bounds but were not cropped.
workflow_feedback.wrapped_loci: The stacked heading correction has component boxes. Wrapped inventory text blocks also include component boxes.
workflow_feedback.label17: A single crop was warranted by H’s explicit rewritten-number note. No separately decipherable older numeral was supplied for label17.
workflow_feedback.independence: Only assigned scan035, its supplied packet inputs, the reader brief and the allowed current notation table were inspected. Other page images, other readers and root decisions were not consulted.
workflow_feedback.forbidden_processes: No OCR, recognition, PDF text extraction, external research or LaTeX compilation was used.
workflow_feedback.mathematics: Mathematical context was a reading cue only. No theorem was proposed, no source mathematics was silently repaired, and no proof/computation check is claimed.
workflow_feedback.count_interpretation: Against-C counts include removal/change of doubt markup and are not an error count. H uncertainty-only comparisons with the same primary reading are false. Explicit confident H notes are not marked_in_H doubts.
workflow_feedback.final_file_checks: All 20 C doubt IDs are covered; every c/h finding string is an exact supplied-witness substring (or absent); 15 crop files exist; reading.tex passes a plain brace-balance check. No compilation or mathematical proof check was performed.
